title: Playboy's Complete Massage Europe black video with audio
symptom: The PAL/50 Hz European disc starts on black while audio continues. This was first reported after the USA pressing had been played, but PAL and NTSC VMPEG NVRAM use separate files.
expected: With a clean PAL VMPEG NVRAM store, the European title should present its intended opening video while audio plays.

hypotheses.hardware_explanation: The PAL title may resume an invalid saved program state from its own Mono-I PAL+VMPEG NVRAM store, selecting audio while leaving external video hidden or seeking to a non-picture boundary.
supporting_evidence: The title starts with audio but a black picture, which is compatible with an invalid resume position or external-video state.
A nonempty PAL VMPEG NVRAM file existed before this report.
After all player NVRAM stores were cleared, the Europe pressing was booted first and played normally.
contradicting_evidence: PAL and NTSC VMPEG stores are separate, so the European title did not directly read the USA title's NTSC file.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Boot the European disc from the now-clean PAL VMPEG store. If it remains black with audio, stale NVRAM is falsified and the first CDIC/VMPEG visibility or stream divergence must be traced.

manual_verification.notes: User reproduced a black PAL/50 Hz opening while audio played. Next: boot Europe first with the clean PAL VMPEG store, wait ten seconds without clicking, and report whether video appears and whether audio continues or loops.

With all PAL/NTSC/legacy NVRAM stores cleared, the user booted the Europe pressing first and it played normally. This confirms persistence affected the prior black-with-audio boot, but because PAL and NTSC stores were separate it does not prove the USA save itself was read by Europe. Windowboxing remains a separate presentation observation.
